title: Car tech worth paying for vs skip (my opinion)
hook: Car features I'd pay extra for, and ones I'd skip. Honest opinion from a tech guy.
caption:
Upgrading to a higher variant just for 'more tech'? Here's my honest take as someone who works in tech 👇

✅ WORTH IT (for most Indian buyers):
• A good-quality reversing camera or 360° camera. Tight parking and narrow lanes make it genuinely useful daily.
• Android Auto / Apple CarPlay (wireless is a nice bonus). Your phone's maps and music beat most built-in systems.
• Safety features like more airbags and ESC. Not flashy, but they matter most.

🤔 THINK TWICE:
• A giant screen if the software is laggy. Always test the screen's response in the showroom.
• Gimmicky features you'll use once and forget.
• Paying a big jump in price for one 'cool' feature. Check what else that variant actually adds.

This is my opinion, not a rule. Your use case matters.

Which feature would YOU never compromise on? Comment 👇
